cardOverview.overviewText: A rewards-centric card offering accelerated Membership Rewards points on everyday transactions, including travel, dining, and e-commerce. Cardholders benefit from flexible redemption options and milestone rewards worth up to ₹5,000 annually.

items.child: Upto Rs 10,000 Instant Cashback on Apple Products
20% Discount on Dining Bills at Select Partner Restaurants

benefitRows.name: Apple
benefitRows.description: Upto Rs 10,000 Instant Cashback on Apple Products
benefitRows.offer: Up to ₹10,000 instant cashback on Apple products at Apple Saket, Apple BKC, and the Apple Online Store.
benefitRows.duration: Offer valid from 3 October 2024 to 15 January 2025.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to your Apple ID account via the Apple website or Apple Store app. Use your American Express card enrolled in the Membership Rewards program to shop for Apple products and redeem Membership Rewards points against purchases. For any queries, contact American Express customer care at 1-800-419-2122 or visit the AMEX Support page.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.description: 20% Discount on Dining Bills at Select Partner Restaurants
benefitRows.offer: Get special dining discounts of up to 20% off using your American Express Reward credit card at select restaurants.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 25% off at 70+ restaurants. Complete the payment using your American Express Membership Rewards credit card to unlock the offer.
